method: 5 interleaved before/after rounds; each round spawns a fresh `acos bench launch --runs 1` process. before = ACOS_BOOT_CACHE=0 (full Vm::new + prepareMainLooper + ActivityThread + attach); after = ACOS_CACHE_DIR warm (disk ACOSSNAP load + Vm::restore).

definition.before: RuntimeTemplate::boot internal framework bring-up (Vm::new + framework stages + ACOSSNAP capture)
definition.after: cache load + checksum + Vm::restore (cold class relink) + BootImage capture

note: The cold cache restore still pays the ~54 ms class relink (no serialized linked-class image), so it reaches ~65 ms, not the 12.8 ms in-process restore of BENCHMARKS.md 8.13. Serializing the BootImage is the next lever. `acos launch` is NOT wired to the cache (T-43 binder-identity re-seed is missing); the real launch path is unchanged (see w96a-launch.json).
